item.text: {"verdicts":[{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0016-E001","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"BGD e-GOV CIRT published a page titled “Bangladesh Cybersecurity Strategy 2021-2025” on 20 September 2021.","notes":["The excerpt supports the title, publisher/agency attribution, and publication date.","It does not establish that the strategy was in force during 2023 or provide substantive policy-framework details."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0016-E002","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":["The excerpt identifies Sheikh Hasina as the speaker and Bangladesh’s Prime Minister, and dates the UN General Assembly record to 22 September 2023.","The agenda information identifies the event as the General Assembly general debate."]}]}
